newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA re-affirms NBS Holdings ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA re-affirms NBS Holdings ratings.

text.p: International rating agency IBCA on Thursday re-affirmed the domestic short-term A1 and long-term A ratings of financial institution NBS Holdings Ltd.
The agency also re-affirmed the group's legal "4" rating.
"The rating indicates the highest capacity for timely repayment in the short-term and a low expectation of investment risk in the long-term," IBCA said.
It said NBS Holdings was a successful bank focusing on its traditional core business, home loans.
"With the fifth largest market share, it is an important player in the domestic banking industry."
NBS Holdings has as its major shareholders the Norwich Group (21.3 percent stake), RMB Holdings Limited (19.9 percent) and the Eskom Pension Fund (10.7 percent).
"Given the resources of these shareholders, it is our opinion that additional capital could be made available to the bank, in need. On this basis, a legal rating of "4" is accorded," IBCA said.
